summary: UNSW Sydney funds international research students through the Research Training Program International (RTPI) Scholarship and the University International Postgraduate Award (UIPA). Both pay tuition and a living stipend of A$39,991 a year at the 2027 rate, with an allowance for Overseas Student Health Cover. The next international deadline is 16 April 2027.
meta_title: UNSW RTPI and UIPA scholarships: A$39,991 a year (2027)
meta_description: UNSW Sydney's RTPI and UIPA pay tuition and a A$39,991 stipend (2027 rate) for international PhD and research master's students. Deadline 16 April 2027.
covers: A living stipend of A$39,991 a year at the 2027 rate.
Tuition fees: the RTPI through the Australian Government's fee offset, the UIPA from UNSW.

An Overseas Student Health Cover allowance (single cover) for four years for a doctorate or two for a research master's, plus relocation and thesis allowances. RTPI holders can ask the Department of Home Affairs to waive the visa fee.
eligibility: International candidates for a PhD or research master's (such as an MPhil) at UNSW Sydney.
You must meet UNSW's higher degree research admission and candidature conditions.
Tuition Fee Scholarships (tuition from UNSW, stipend from the faculty or supervisor) share the same deadline.
how_to_apply: Find a supervisor and apply for your research degree at UNSW, which also puts you up for the scholarships.
Submit by 16 April 2027 for the international round.
Read UNSW's scholarship guidelines and terms before you apply.
watch_out: Research master's and PhD only; coursework master's are not covered.
Funding is competitive and usually needs a strong research record or publications.
Allowances are contributions and may not cover the full cost.
documents: A UNSW higher degree research application
A supervisor's support, CV and research proposal as UNSW requires

faq.q: How much is the UNSW RTPI or UIPA stipend in 2027?
faq.a: A$39,991 a year at the 2027 rate.

faq.q: When is the UNSW international scholarship deadline?
faq.a: 16 April 2027, for the RTPI, UIPA and Tuition Fee Scholarships.

faq.q: Do UNSW research scholarships cover tuition?
faq.a: Yes. The RTPI includes a fee offset and the UIPA includes tuition fees funded by UNSW.
